A1: $p=2$, $q=10$. Printed total: 4.

parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: *M1: attempt to integrate $v$, increasing a power by 1 and changing the coefficient in at least one same term; $s=vt$ is M0. A1: $s=-0.025t^4+0.6t^3-3t^2+5.6t+c$ (or unsimplified $-0.1t^4/4+1.8t^3/3-6t^2/2+5.6t+c$). DM1: attempt distance from $t=0$ to $t=14$, $F(14)-F(0)=176.4$; splitting at 2 is allowed only as $[F(14)-F(2)]+[F(2)-F(0)]$. DM1: attempt distance from $t=14$ to $t=15$, $\pm[F(15)-F(14)]=8.025$ in magnitude. Reference values: $F(2)=18/5=3.6$, $F(14)=882/5=176.4$, $F(15)=1347/8=168.375$. A1: total distance $=176.4+8.025=184.425\,\mathrm{m}=7377/40\,\mathrm{m}$ WWW; condone 184 or better. SC with no integration, maximum 3: B1 for $\int_0^{14}v\,dt=176.4$; B1 for $\int_{14}^{15}v\,dt=-8.025$ or $|\int_{14}^{15}v\,dt|=8.025$; B1 for total $184.425=7377/40$, condone 184 or better. SC with no integration and no consideration of the two areas, maximum 1: B1 for $\int_0^{15}|v|\,dt=184.425=7377/40$, condone 184 or better. Printed total: 5.
